v1ThreeDimensionalView.implementation: three independently positioned orthogonal slice families
planes: XZ horizontal slices at selected Y positions
XY longitudinal slices at selected Z positions
YZ cross-room slices at selected X positions
v1ThreeDimensionalView.sliceDistribution: for count > 1, redistribute the family evenly through the room interior using relative positions i/(count+1); count 1 retains the selected anchor position
v1ThreeDimensionalView.rangeInvariant: changing only orthogonal slice count is a visualization-topology change and must not change the shared display range or recolor the existing 2D heatmap
v1ThreeDimensionalView.mustNot: represent a single floor-level XZ slice as the complete 3D field

viewSelection.invariant: adding the 3D field view does not remove or redefine the existing 2D heatmap

displayRange.shared: all active views of the same analysis configuration use one color range
displayRange.comparisonInvariant: within the same analysis configuration, automatic range updates may expand to contain newly larger values but must not shrink merely because the field was attenuated
displayRange.analysisChange: frequency, frequency range, aggregation, field identity or explicit field analysis signature change may establish a new automatic range
displayRange.explicitReset: a caller may explicitly reset the display range and request re-normalization for the current analysis configuration

controls.sliceOpacity: S3D value 0..1; AcousticMate UI exposes 1..100 percent with logarithmic mapping, reserving 75 percent of slider travel for 1..20 percent and 25 percent for 20..100 percent
